why.label: Why Explain Exists
why.p1: People don't fail interviews because they're not good enough.
why.p2: They fail because they've never actually practised. Not once. Not properly. Most people walk into the most important conversation of their career having rehearsed nothing — because there was nowhere to rehearse.
why.em1:
The first time they sit
in the chair —
is the real interview.
why.tagline: Explain is the world's first AI interview practice platform that feels like the real thing. So when the real thing comes — you're already ready.

pillars.name: Clarity
pillars.body: We remove the mystery of interviews. You see the question structure, the competencies being assessed, and the benchmark before you walk in. Clarity is the most underrated competitive advantage.

pillars.name: Structure
pillars.hl: A framework that turns pressure into performance
pillars.body: Every session follows a proven architecture — opening, competency questions, HR questions, debrief. You learn to map your experience to what interviewers actually need. No more guessing.
pillars.micro: Structure beats talent in the room.

pillars.name: Coaching
pillars.body: While you answer, Explain's coaching engine watches your delivery, flags hesitations, and surfaces cues in real time. You don't just practice — you improve with every question.
pillars.micro: The best coaches speak during the game.

pillars.name: Scoring
pillars.body: After each answer, you receive a breakdown across Clarity, Depth, Confidence, and Delivery — calibrated against the Top 5% benchmark for your specific role and industry.
pillars.micro: You can't improve what you can't measure.

pillars.name: Confidence
pillars.hl: Walk in ready. Walk out proud.
pillars.body: Confidence isn't fake it till you make it. It's the natural result of genuine preparation. After enough sessions with Explain, you don't just feel ready — you are ready.
pillars.micro: Confidence is a skill. We build it.

founder.label: A Message from the Founder
founder.p1: I built Explain because I lived the problem.
founder.p2: I have sat in interview rooms and watched people who were brilliant — genuinely brilliant — walk out empty-handed. Not because they weren't good enough. Because the process was a black box. It rewarded those who had been coached, those who had insider knowledge, those who had simply done it before.
founder.p3: Traditional interviews were never designed to find the best person. They were designed to find the most familiar person — familiar with the format, the language, the unspoken rules. That is not a merit system. That is a privilege system.
founder.p4: The Interview Chair is our answer. A place where every candidate — regardless of background, country, or connections — sits across from two AI interviewers who know the role, the industry, and the exact job spec. Where the coaching is honest. Where the scoring is real. Where the preparation is fair.
founder.p5: Our mission is simple: clarity for every candidate, everywhere. The nurse in Lagos. The engineer in Warsaw. The graduate in Birmingham who never had a mentor. Every one of them deserves to walk in prepared.
founder.quote: Every seat at that table should be earned on merit. The Interview Chair is how we get you there.
founder.name: Francis Cobbinah
